subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: he said to the shoe maker you are a big block head you have done the reverse of what i desired you i told you to make one of the shoes larger than the other and instead of that you have made one of them smaller than the other Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation He said to the shoe maker, "You are a big block head! You have done the reverse of what I desired you. I told you to make one of the shoes larger than the other. And instead of that you have made one of them smaller than the other." Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 200
